Dynamic estimation to examine information release

```{r}
first_stage_renewable <- first_stage_data_clean  %>% 
  filter(auction_before!= auction_after) %>% 
  mutate(day_ahead_renewable_forecast = day_ahead_renewable_forecast/1000,
         wind_solar_tot = wind_solar_tot/1000,
    intraday_update_renewables = intraday_update_renewables/1000,
         unpredicted_renewables = unpredicted_renewables/1000)

```


```{r}
m_basic_renew_int <- lm(
  price_diff ~ intraday_update_renewables*as.factor(auction_before) + gen_tot+
    as.factor(year) + as.factor(month)+as.factor(weekday) + as.factor(creneau) ,
  data=  first_stage_renewable)

vcov_cluster <- vcovCL(m_basic_renew_int, type = "HC0", cluster = ~ creneau)
# Erreurs standard clusterisées
cl_se_basic_renew_int <- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))

m_control_renew_int <- lm(
  price_diff ~ intraday_update_renewables*as.factor(auction_before) + unpredicted_renewables +
    day_ahead_renewable_forecast*as.factor(auction_before)+   gen_tot+
    as.factor(year) + as.factor(month) +as.factor(weekday) + as.factor(creneau)  ,
  data= first_stage_renewable)

vcov_cluster <- vcovCL(m_control_renew_int, type = "HC0", cluster = ~ creneau)
# Erreurs standard clusterisées
cl_se_control_renew_int <- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
# Obtenir tous les coefficients du modèle
coefficients <- coef(m_control_renew_int)

target_coeffs_id <- coef(m_control_renew_int)[grep("intraday_update_renewables|intraday_update_renewables:as.factor\\(auction_before\\)", names(coef(m_control_renew_int)))]



id_serie <- target_coeffs_id[1]
id_serie <- c(id_serie, target_coeffs_id[2:length(target_coeffs_id)] - as.numeric(id_serie[1]))
# Extract standard errors for the relevant coefficients (intraday_update_renewables and interactions)
target_sd_id <- cl_se_control_renew_int[grep("intraday_update_renewables|intraday_update_renewables:as.factor\\(auction_before\\)", names(cl_se_control_renew_int))]

# Get all model coefficients

target_coeffs_da <- coef(m_control_renew_int)[grep("day_ahead_renewable_forecast|day_ahead_renewable_forecast:as.factor\\(auction_before\\)", names(coef(m_control_renew_int)))]

# Filter for day_ahead_renewable_forecast and its interactions
da_serie <- target_coeffs_da[1]
da_serie <- c(da_serie, target_coeffs_da[2:length(target_coeffs_id)] - as.numeric(da_serie[1]))


target_sd_da <- cl_se_control_renew_int[grep("day_ahead_renewable_forecast|day_ahead_renewable_forecast:as.factor\\(auction_before\\)", names(cl_se_control_renew_int))]



# Print the coefficients
abciss <- c(1:7)
ggplot()+
  geom_point(aes(x = abciss, y = id_serie, color = "Intraday Update"))+
  geom_errorbar(aes(x = abciss, ymin = id_serie - 2*target_sd_id, ymax = id_serie + 2*target_sd_id, color = "Intraday Update"), width = 0.2)+
  geom_point(aes(x = abciss, y = da_serie, color = "Day Ahead"))+
  geom_errorbar(aes(x = abciss, ymin = da_serie - 2*target_sd_da, ymax = da_serie + 2*target_sd_da, color = "Day Ahead"), width = 0.2)+
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "Renewable Dynamic effects",
       x = "Auction",
       y = "EUR/GWh")+
  theme_minimal()

```


```{r}
library(sandwich)  # Pour vcovCL
library(lmtest)    # Pour coeftest

# Créer un dataframe pour stocker les résultats
results <- data.frame()

# Boucle sur chaque catégorie de référence de 0 à 6
for (ref_level in 0:6) {
  
  # Fixer la référence de auction_before
  first_stage_renewable$auction_before <- relevel(as.factor(first_stage_renewable$auction_before), ref = as.character(ref_level))
  
  # Estimer le modèle
  m_control_renew_int <- lm(
    price_diff ~ intraday_update_renewables * as.factor(auction_before) + 
      unpredicted_renewables + day_ahead_renewable_forecast * as.factor(auction_before) +  
      gen_tot + as.factor(year) + as.factor(month) + as.factor(weekday) + as.factor(creneau),
    data = first_stage_renewable
  )

  # Calcul des erreurs standard clusterisées
  vcov_cluster <- vcovCL(m_control_renew_int, type = "HC0", cluster = ~ creneau)
  se_cluster <- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))

  # Extraire les coefficients et erreurs standard
  coefs <- coef(m_control_renew_int)
  coefs_names <- names(coefs)

  # Extraire uniquement le coefficient de intraday_update_renewables
  coef_value <- coef(m_control_renew_int)["intraday_update_renewables"]
  se_value <- se_cluster["intraday_update_renewables"]

  coef_value2 <- coef(m_control_renew_int)["day_ahead_renewable_forecast"]
  se_value2 <- se_cluster["day_ahead_renewable_forecast"]
  
  # Stocker les résultats
  results <- rbind(results, data.frame(ref_level = ref_level, 
                  coef = coef_value, std_error = se_value, name = "intraday_update_renewables"))
  results <- rbind(results, data.frame(ref_level = ref_level,
                  coef = coef_value2, std_error = se_value2, name = "day_ahead_renewable_forecast"))
  
}

# Afficher les résultats
print(results)

# Sauvegarde dans un fichier CSV si besoin
#write.csv(results, "coefficients_by_reference.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```
